levels.name: NYC Bar
levels.blocker: BODY model model2 — 3 world LightMap records get an iLightActors run UED22 leaves at -1 (Lights 484 vs 478, LightBits 6003 vs 5891); leaf permeating regions are clean (0/155 differ). Per-surf raytrace pass, same family as UNATCO N=116/WanChai N=45. N=151's leaf-permeating bug is FIXED: the beam-clip plane (FPlane(Light, edge)) wasn't normalized before testing against the editor's world-unit epsilon (+-0.25), so a ~1e4-magnitude cross product made the effective epsilon ~40000x too tight and let the beam survive extra portal hops.

levels.name: UNATCO HQ
levels.blocker: BODY model model2 — world Model.Lights RUNS differ on 13 of 214 lightmaps, both directions (native-only lights, UED-only lights, one lightmap empty vs seven). Same family as the WanChai N=45/OceanLab N=44 lighting-gather work, not yet fixed here. N=29's blocker is FIXED: _patch_native_surf_refs now assigns texture_ref=0 for an untextured surf instead of leaving the marshaller's per-brush texture dedup ordinal in place (Brush516's untextured poly 2 got ordinal 2, shipped as a bogus object ref).

levels.name: OceanLab
levels.blocker: BODY model model2 — world Model2's LightBits differ on 3 lightmaps, 28 bytes total; every geometry array is byte-exact. N=46's Bounds/LeafHulls bug is FIXED: Pass D's zone SPLIT must KILL the original chain node and append every fragment as a new node, so the post-Pass-D bspCleanup promotes the dead node's coplanar successor (inheriting its children, mirrored on opposite facing); native was reusing the original node in place, which left it heading two chains.

levels.name: WanChai Market
levels.blocker: N=45 Spotlight22: Model.Lights 687 vs 686 — same 4 lightmap light-runs differ, byte-for-byte unchanged. URender::ClipBspSurf + the fixed-point scanline rasterizer are now FULLY PORTED from disassembly (replacing the old empirical pixel-centre stand-in) and a real zone-portal occlusion bug was fixed along the way — but measurement shows the rasterizer was never the cause here (only 2 of ~1300 accept/reject decisions moved). Remaining lead: front-to-back visit ORDER — native's zone-1 span buffer drains before node 59 on all six faces; next probe is a live breakpoint at 0x100198a0 logging iNode/IsFront/ValidLines.

levels.name: UNATCO Island
levels.blocker: BODY model model2 — leaf 26 gets a permeating-light run UED22 leaves empty. NOT the same cause as NYC_Bar's sibling bug (that fix, a beam-clip-plane normalization, left Island unchanged) -- root-caused to the PORTAL GRAPH: zones::collect_portals clips with a plain 1e-4 Sutherland-Hodgman where the editor's FilterThroughSubtree uses SplitWithNode(VeryPrecise) and DISCARDS an SP_Coplanar result, which moves the union-find graph the portal reachability rides on. Only one BSP node references leaf 26 and its portal shape is the open question.
